title: Last week and Games that matter on Home
items: Home has a new section with two tabs. Sunday to Wednesday it opens on Last week; Thursday to Saturday it opens on Games that matter. Either tab can be picked at any time.
Last week shows the model's locked-pick record for the week beside what it expected, its best call and worst miss, the other upsets, the biggest ranking moves, and how your followed teams did.

Games that matter lists the next seven days' games with playoff stakes. Football labels them from the CFP committee ranking and the projected bracket: playoff teams meeting, a playoff team at risk, bubble teams and ranked meetings. Basketball lists games involving bubble teams, with each team's chance of making the field from bracketology.
While Last week is showing, the side panel's recent best call and miss steps aside, so the same calls are not shown twice.
Fixed a script error on every page load that stopped the slow-loading retry message from ever appearing.
